Elon Musk@elonmusk·
Try Tesla self-driving. It will blow your mind!
Alex Rampell@arampell·
I just bought a new Model Y and can confidently say cars and Teslas are no longer the same product.

A car is like a pony or horse. I still like driving a stick shift, it’s fun!

Tesla with FSD is a transportation robot.

I had one of the first Model 3s in 2017. FSD was basically slightly better cruise control. Great on the highway. But honestly felt oversold.

So I have been driving a BMW for the past 3 years. Great horse, fun to drive.

But tried FSD recently and holy shit — it’s a personal Waymo. Works perfectly. I just went to the Fremont factory to get my new car, entered my address 30+ mins away, pushed a button, and got home without doing a thing.

I don’t think most people realize how good this is, probably because they only experienced an early version previously. This is 1000x better. Metaphor for AI writ large. Like trying GPT 3.5 and thinking it’s cute and hallucinates, and dismissing it…while Astra launches in 2026 and is orders of magnitude more capable.

Tesla in 2026 is moving at an insane pace

Roadster, Cybercab, Robotaxi, Optimus, Semi, FSD, Energy, Terafab

Just look at what has happened across the company this year:

• Next-gen Roadster — unveiling officially set for October 1

• Model Y L — expanded from China to the U.S. with six seats and a longer wheelbase

• Cybercab — production started at Giga Texas and it has now entered Robotaxi service with no steering wheel or pedals

• Robotaxi — crossed 1 MILLION unsupervised miles as Tesla continues expanding the network

• FSD V15 — complete overhaul of the software architecture targeted for late 2026 / early 2027

• Optimus — first production lines are being installed at Fremont while the V3 reveal is still ahead

• Tesla Semi — production ramp starting this year, with European deliveries beginning in 2027

• Energy — deployed 13.5 GWh in Q2, while Megapack 3 production is coming online later this year

• Terafab — Tesla + SpaceXAI are building out a massive vertically integrated chip manufacturing effort in Texas

And the core business is moving too:

• Record Q2 deliveries — 480,126 vehicles
• All-time record quarterly revenue — $28.2 BILLION

Tesla is scaling vehicles, autonomy, robotics, energy and AI infrastructure at the same time

And somehow the pace is still accelerating insanely

Very important article from the head of China's Ministry of State Security, laying out China's view of top AI risks.

First is social & political risk from AI content.

Second, is cyber, citing Mythos:

"Second, the landscape of cyber offense and defense is undergoing a disruptive transformation. Marked by the recent release of large models such as “Mythos” (Claude Mythos) and “Cyber” (GPT-5.5-Cyber) by U.S. technology companies, AI is significantly improving the efficiency and sophistication of vulnerability discovery, malware development, and cyber weaponization. Cyber conflict is entering a new phase characterized by industrialized vulnerability exploitation, fully automated offense and defense, and AI-versus-AI confrontation. Some countries and organizations are now capable of rapidly identifying vulnerabilities at scale, automatically chaining attack paths, and completing complex hacking tasks—substantially lowering the technical barriers and costs of conducting cyberattacks, and creating serious risks for China’s critical IT infrastructure."
